layout.observation: Reference desktop is a dark three-rail browse shell (left nav, central preview catalogue, right support). V0 reconstructs that grammar as an original Signal Shelf with utility bar, rails, and a central card grid. Exact source geometry, labels, and documentation chrome are not copied.
layout.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-initial-e87ed92fcb8c.webp paired with V0 desktop initial cap-f5f8d8d221fe453f6ec3e01e43fd1784
layout.engine_inference: V0 uses a top bar plus three-column desktop and collapsing rails; the reference uses a similar browse-shell partition. Column ratios and source-specific chrome differ by design.
limitations: No observed React Bits mobile reference exists; V0 mobile layout is original responsive interpretation only and is not used as reference-fidelity evidence.

typography.observation: Reference uses a dark UI type system with compact labels and a prominent browse heading. V0 uses original system-sans stacks, italic emphasis on the display word, and four roles (display, section, label, metadata). Source font files and names are not used.
typography.engine_inference: Glyph geometry differs because licensed/source fonts were not retrieved; hierarchy of display vs metadata is transferred.
limitations: Typeface identity is approximated with system stacks.

color.observation: Reference concentrates luminous violet/magenta/blue on previews and actions over a near-black shell. V0 reconstructs a charcoal shell with localized gradient signals on tiles and primary controls.
color.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-initial-e87ed92fcb8c.webp and desktop-mid-scroll-04d151ae6295.webp paired with V0 desktop initial and mid-scroll
color.engine_inference: Palette transfer is principle-level (dark shell, localized luminous accents), not sampled source CSS values.
limitations: Colors were read from stills, not extracted from source stylesheets.

spacing.observation: Reference catalogue uses regular card gutters and compact rail padding. V0 uses clamp-based section gaps and a dense central shelf with stable gutters.
spacing.engine_inference: V0 regularizes catalogue rhythm; exact source spacing tokens are not reproduced.

asset_treatment.observation: Reference previews are component demos and media. V0 uses original CSS-generated signal motifs only; no source media, icons, or component previews were copied.
asset_treatment.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-mid-scroll-04d151ae6295.webp paired with V0 desktop signature capture
asset_treatment.engine_inference: Asset treatment is intentionally non-reproductive because of MIT+Commons Clause and one-off observe-only rights.
limitations: Fidelity of preview artwork is inherently partial; source media was never retrieved.

depth.observation: Reference depth comes from layered panels, preview frames, and luminous inner fields. V0 uses panel separation, inset edges, a shallow hover lift, and an inner focus ring.
depth.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-initial-e87ed92fcb8c.webp paired with V0 desktop initial and signature
depth.engine_inference: No persistent WebGL/3D is claimed; depth is CSS layering.

hierarchy.observation: Reference hierarchy is browse-first: heading, filters, then repeated previews. V0 mirrors display heading, toolbar, tile dominance, and quiet rails/metadata.
hierarchy.engine_inference: Four-tier type/weight steps carry the browse hierarchy without source copy.
limitations: Mobile hierarchy is original interpretation only; there is no React Bits mobile reference still.

motion.observation: Reference stills cannot prove hover timing. V0 implements a token-driven signal-constellation hover/focus (shallow lift and inner ring). The human reviewer noted the hover is subtle and accepted it as non-blocking.
motion.evidence_source: V0 desktop signature cap-19b24b605bd46ba1cae401c3b79d2da3 paired with reference desktop initial; no reference hover still exists
motion.engine_inference: Motion is a KINETIC token approximation of browse-focus intent, not a measurement of source easing.
limitations: No React Bits hover/motion still was captured; signature subtlety is recorded, not treated as a blocking fidelity failure.

scroll_choreography.observation: After REVISE, V0 desktop final uses scroll_to_px 657 (true page bottom). Last card row and back-to-top are in view; hero is gone. That end-of-list state is distinct from initial by sha256 and pHash. Reference desktop-final shows the catalogue bottom analogously.
scroll_choreography.evidence_source: reference/captures/desktop-final-136b715b6a12.webp paired with V0 desktop mid-scroll and corrected final
scroll_choreography.engine_inference: End-of-list evidence is now a genuine max-scroll state, not the on-screen #notes rail.
limitations: Scroll-linked source motion, if any, remains unproven by stills.

interaction.observation: Reference browse affordances include search, category, and preview focus. V0 implements search, category filter, theme toggle, tile hover/focus, mobile menu, and return-to-top. Signature hover remains the inspected interaction and was kept as-is per human REVISE item 3.
interaction.evidence_source: V0 desktop signature and initial paired with reference desktop initial
interaction.engine_inference: Interaction grammar is transferred as browse controls plus one localized tile focus; source widgets are not cloned.
limitations: No reference hover capture exists. V0 mobile menu-open is technical evidence only.

transition_behavior.observation: Source transition curves are unmeasured. V0 transitions are motion-token governed; reduced-motion capture matches the static top-of-page rest state by design.
transition_behavior.evidence_source: V0 desktop reduced-motion cap-d20bfde6e7acb358fdeaa1862839e7b2 and signature capture; motion-token report
transition_behavior.engine_inference: Reduced-motion equals initial static top because transforms and transitions are suppressed.
limitations: Equivalence to source timing is not claimed.

narrative_pacing.observation: Reference paces a dense catalogue rather than a long editorial chapter. V0 uses short intro, regular card bands, and a quiet end-of-list return. Corrected final still proves the catalogue actually ends.
narrative_pacing.evidence_source: reference desktop mid/final paired with V0 mid-scroll and corrected final
narrative_pacing.engine_inference: Pacing is browse-catalogue, deliberately unlike Wanaka editorial chapters.
limitations: Length equivalence to the live source page is not claimed.

coverage_summary: All 12 dimensions carry paired desktop reference stills and V0 captures. Browse-shell layout, catalogue hierarchy, localized luminous color, and end-of-list scroll are reconstructed from one-off observe-only desktop evidence. Motion, transitions, and preview assets are token-governed approximations. There is no observed React Bits mobile reference; V0 mobile captures remain technical/original interpretation only and are not treated as reference fidelity. Human APPROVE is for V0 fidelity only.
approval_reason: Explicit human APPROVE 2026-09-04: the corrected React Bits V0 fidelity study is acceptable. This approval is for V0 fidelity only. Preserve V0 non-deployable and non-original; mobile remains technical/original interpretation only where no reference evidence exists; no fabricated winner; human-only final V1/V2 taste decision.
